text: Salvage and soundings. What can I raise for you?
Mind the drip. Always dripping, me.
{player}! Fancy a swim?
You've been down to the city! The temple! What was it like?
Listen to that thunder. Nobody sane is at sea tonight.
Storm's right on top of us. Stay in the dry a while.
Every timber in the harbour's groaning. Ugly night.
Wretched rain. Gets into everything.
Rain again. Good for the cisterns, bad for the soul.
You're dripping on my floor, by the way.
Late to be wandering about.
Night's when the cursed come walking. Keep a lantern lit.
Can't sleep either, eh?
Up with the gulls, I see.
Early start, {player}.
Mist'll burn off by mid-morning.
Happy {festival}, {player}! Everyone's in good spirits.
It's the {festival}. Half the town's drunk and the other half's working on it.

options.label: I'll buy a diving helmet. (22 doubloons)

text: Four minutes of air in the brass. It only breathes for you while your head's under, and refills the moment you surface.
Wear boots with it and you'll walk the bottom quicker. The bell rings when you're down to half a minute.
Vesh Amaru, the drowned city, west of Serpent's Hollow and far south. Streets, houses, a temple, and a grotto under it.
Every wreck you sink, too. And there's always something on the reef if you look.
